For the form error element, I'm deciding to only render it when an error actually exists rather than hiding it with styling, so tests checking for its presence or absence behave predictably.

I'm also weighing whether typing in the field should clear the error automatically. I'll go with clearing it on input since that's the expected UX pattern, though I want to make sure that doesn't conflict with test sequences that check error persistence immediately after a failed submission.

I'll scope errors per-field rather than one global message, placing each beneath its relevant input and focusing the first invalid one. If several fields fail at once, multiple error elements can show simultaneously.

Successful actions should clear all errors. I'm also considering edge cases like adding an expense with no people — rather than disabling the button (which would break tests waiting for it to be clickable), I'll keep the form always rendered with testids present, showing a placeholder/empty-state message and an error if someone tries to add an expense prematurely. I'll skip the placeholder option and just default the payer select to the first person whenever people exist, keeping the selection persistent across submissions. For splits, everyone should be checked by default including newly added people, and after submitting an expense I'll reset description, amount, and split checkboxes back to all-checked, while leaving the payer selection as-is unless there's a reason to reset it too.

I also need to preserve checkbox states when re-rendering the split section after adding a person, only re-rendering the people-dependent parts rather than the whole form. For the amount field, I'm switching to type="text" with inputmode="decimal" instead of type="number", since Playwright can't fill invalid characters into a number input but needs to test rejection of bad values like "abc" or "-5" — I'll keep validation lenient, maybe allowing comma thousands separators.

I'm working out the parsing logic: trimming, stripping a leading dollar sign, handling comma-grouped numbers, and allowing leading/trailing decimal points like ".5" or "5." as valid. Decimal places beyond two should trigger a clear "at most 2 decimal places" error, negative or zero values get a "greater than $0" message, non-numeric input gets a "like 24.50" format hint, and I'm considering capping unreasonably large amounts.

I'm settling on converting the validated amount into integer cents by parsing the integer and decimal portions separately, with a length check to guard against overflow. For description and name fields, I'm requiring non-empty trimmed values, adding a generous max length, and planning to enforce case-insensitive uniqueness for person names while considering whitespace normalization.

I'm working out friendly, specific error messages: empty name prompts, duplicate name messages that reference the existing person's casing (so "ana" vs "Ana" gets a clear "already on the trip" note), and expense validation messages for missing people, empty descriptions, and empty or invalid amounts—each phrased with helpful examples. For splitting amounts evenly among people, I'm writing a function that distributes remainder cents one at a time to the first few people so totals always add up exactly, plus a helper to get the ordered list of people included in a split. Now I'm starting the balance computation function that tracks what each person paid versus their fair share across all expenses...

For settling up, I'm writing a greedy algorithm that repeatedly matches the person owed the most against the person owing the most, transferring the smaller of the two amounts until all balances reach zero -- since total credits always equal total debts exactly, the loop is guaranteed to terminate cleanly.

Now I'm figuring out how to efficiently re-render the controls panel only when people actually change, by comparing a signature string and preserving previous checkbox states and selected payer values keyed by person id so toggling doesn't reset user selections.

Setting payerSel.value by name works since it matches the option value. Now I'm rebuilding the split section, showing a placeholder message when there are no people yet.

Otherwise I'm generating a checkbox chip for each person, preserving prior checked state or defaulting to checked, so I need to double check how the empty-state paragraph interacts with the test ID attribute on the container.

Now I'm moving to the expense form submit handler, validating that people exist before logging an expense and checking the description field isn't blank before proceeding.

Still writing validation logic...

Building the expense split logic...

After adding, I'll focus back on the description field so users can quickly add another expense, and announce the addition with details on amount, payer, and split for accessibility.

Since the balances list may be offscreen after this, I'll also show a brief inline success message like "Added Groceries · $45.00" near the submit button that fades after a few seconds, giving sighted users visible confirmation too.

Now I'm writing the validation logic for adding a person to the trip, checking for an empty name and showing an error if so before proceeding.

I'll use dup.name instead for the suggestion so it reflects the actual existing person's name rather than the newly typed one. Now I'm writing the showError function, which clears existing errors and creates a paragraph element to display the validation message.

On mobile, focusing scrolls the field into view nicely. Checking screen reader behavior: focusing the invalid field announces it along with the describedby error text, plus the live region fires too, which seems redundant but acceptable.

I'm wiring up listeners so errors clear automatically once the user starts correcting the relevant field—matching on the control reference for inputs and checkboxes, and clearing the "no people" error specifically when someone adds a person. Now I'm building the function that renders the people list as chips, each showing the person's initial, their name, and a remove button (hidden for anyone currently involved in an expense), with event delegation handling the remove clicks and an empty-state message using Canadian spelling for "travelling."

I'm drafting the people-count note text, something like "You can remove someone until they're part of an expense," and sketching the balances renderer which computes each person's net position, labels it as "Gets back," "Owes," or "All square," and scales a visual bar against the largest absolute balance.

Now I'm writing the settle view: handling empty state with "Nothing to settle yet," an all-even state with "Everyone's even," and a summary line counting how many payments settle the trip, followed by building each transfer row with payer, arrow icon, and payee.

I'm also building the expenses list, rendering each entry with its payer and a description of who the expense was split between.

Writing clipboard copy logic...

Now I'm wiring up the reset flow — clicking start reveals the confirm buttons, keep cancels back to the start state, and clear wipes people and expenses, resets undo, saves, re-renders, and announces the trip was cleared. I'm also adding a storage listener so other tabs reloading cleared state stay in sync, making sure load() resets to empty state when storage is null. Then I start drafting the preview update function, checking first whether there are any people at all.

I'm working out the preview text logic: showing guidance when no one's checked, singular vs plural share messages, and a shareSentence helper that explains even splits versus uneven ones where leftover cents go to whoever joined first (or in join order if there are multiple leftover cents) — and I'm weighing whether the preview needs aria-live since it updates on every keystroke.

I'm wiring up event listeners for the amount input, split mode toggle, and tool buttons, plus select-all/none logic that updates checkboxes and clears split errors. For removing a person, I'm writing the click delegation that finds the person by id, blocks removal if they're involved in the split, splices them out, clears undo state and errors, saves and re-renders, then figures out where to move focus afterward among the remaining remove buttons.

Now I'm handling expense deletion similarly: locating the clicked item's position, splicing it from state while storing it for undo, saving and re-rendering, then shifting focus to a nearby delete button or the undo button if the list is now empty, along with an announcement for screen readers.

The undo button restores the removed expense at its original index, re-saves and re-renders, then focuses the restored item's delete button with an announcement. A dismiss control clears the undo state and moves focus to the expenses heading, and I'm placing the undo bar above the expense list with a message describing what was removed.

Writing the main render function...

I'm also checking that control checkboxes preserve their previous checked states when people are added, so existing selections aren't lost, and planning to render icons as inline SVG fragments inserted via contextual fragments rather than innerHTML strings.

For the brand mark, I'm sketching a simple boat-shaped icon—a circle backdrop with a hull silhouette and waterline—to use as the small logo mark in the header.

Still writing shape coordinates...

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-CA">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Even Keel · Split trip costs fairly</title>
<meta name="description" content="Even Keel splits trip expenses between friends and shows who pays whom so everyone ends up even.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1F3A4D">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 40 40'%3E%3Ccircle cx='20' cy='20' r='20' fill='%23C2462B'/%3E%3Cpath d='M0.23 23H39.77A20 20 0 0 1 0.23 23Z' fill='%23152B3A'/%3E%3Cpath d='M9 15h22l-3.6 8H12.6z' fill='%23F6F3EC'/%3E%3Cpath d='M18.4 23h3.2l-.7 8.5h-1.8z' fill='%23F6F3EC'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">

<style>
  :root {
    --harbour: #1F3A4D;
    --harbour-deep: #152B3A;
    --harbour-soft: #3A5568;
    --harbour-mist: #DCE4E9;
    --harbour-fog: #EEF2F4;
    --signal: #C2462B;
    --signal-deep: #A3381F;
    --signal-glow: #FFB49C;
    --signal-wash: #FBEAE3;
    --sea: #2D6A5C;
    --sea-light: #A8DCCB;
    --paper: #F6F3EC;
    --card: #FFFFFF;
    --ink: #18293A;
    --muted: #526577;
    --line: #E2DCD0;
    --line-strong: #7B8995;
    --on-dark-muted: #C3D0D9;
    --focus: var(--signal);
    --radius: 16px;
    --radius-sm: 10px;
    --shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(31, 58, 77, .05), 0 12px 32px -20px rgba(31, 58, 77, .38);
    --font-display: "Fraunces", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif;
    --font-body: "Public Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  [hidden] { display: none !important; }
  html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; color-scheme: light; }
  body {
    margin: 0;

    background: var(--paper);

    font-family: var(--font-body);

  }

    max-width: 1160px; margin: 0 auto;

  .stat dt {
    font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #B6C5CF;
  }
  .stat dd {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums;

<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const STORAGE_KEY = 'even-keel/trip/v1';
  const MAX_CENTS = 1000000000; // $10,000,000.00
  const MAX_NAME = 50;
  const MAX_DESC = 120;

  const money = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-CA', { style: 'currency', currency: 'CAD' });
  const fmt = (cents) => money.format((cents || 0) / 100);

  const listFormat = (typeof Intl.ListFormat === 'function')
    ? new Intl.ListFormat('en-CA', { style: 'long', type: 'conjunction' }) : null;
  const joinNames = (names) => {
    if (listFormat) return listFormat.format(names);
    if (names.length <= 2) return names.join(' and ');
    return names.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' and ' + names[names.length - 1];
  };
  const keyOf = (name) => String(name).normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();
  const plural = (n, one, many) => (n === 1 ? one : many);

  const AMOUNT_ERRORS = {
    empty: 'Enter how much it cost, like 48.50.',
    format: 'Enter the amount as a number, like 48.50.',
    notPositive: 'The amount needs to be more than $0.00.',
    decimals: 'Amounts go to the cent, so use at most 2 decimal places, like 48.50.',
    tooBig: 'That’s more than one expense can hold. Enter up to ' + fmt(MAX_CENTS) + '.'
  };

  const HUES = ['#1F3A4D', '#2D6A5C', '#5B4B6E', '#8A5A14', '#3D5A80'];

  const ICONS = {
    x: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" focusable="false"><path d="M4 4l8 8M12 4l-8 8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>',
    arrow: '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 12" width="20" height="12" focusable="false"><path d="M1 6h16M12.5 1.5 17 6l-4.5 4.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>',
    alert: '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="18" height="18" focusable="false"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8.25" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M10 5.6v5.2" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="10" cy="14.1" r="1.1" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
    check: '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="18" height="18" focusable="false"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8.25" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M6.3 10.4l2.5 2.5 5-5.3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>'
  };

  /* ---------- DOM helpers ---------- */
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  function h(tag, props, ...kids) {
    const node = document.createElement(tag);
    if (props) {
      for (const k of Object.keys(props)) {
        const v = props[k];
        if (v === null || v === undefined || v === false) continue;
        if (k === 'class') node.className = v;
        else node.setAttribute(k, v === true ? '' : String(v));
      }
    }
    appendKids(node, kids);
    return node;
  }
  function appendKids(node, kids) {
    for (const kid of kids) {
      if (kid === null || kid === undefined || kid === false || kid === '') continue;
      if (Array.isArray(kid)) appendKids(node, kid);
      else node.append(kid instanceof Node ? kid : document.createTextNode(String(kid)));
    }
  }
  function icon(name) {
    const s = document.createElement('span');
    s.className = 'icon';
    s.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    s.innerHTML = ICONS[name];
    return s;
  }
  function hueFor(name) {
    let n = 0;
    for (const ch of keyOf(name)) n = (n * 31 + ch.codePointAt(0)) >>> 0;
    return HUES[n % HUES.length];
  }
  function initial(name) {
    const first = Array.from(String(name).trim())[0] || '?';
    return first.toLocaleUpperCase('en-CA');
  }
  function mono(name, size) {
    return h('span', {
      class: 'mono' + (size ? ' mono-' + size : ''),
      'aria-hidden': 'true',
      style: '--hue:' + hueFor(name)
    }, initial(name));
  }

  const ui = {
    statTotal: $('stat-total'), statPeople: $('stat-people'), statExpenses: $('stat-expenses'),
    personForm: $('person-form'), personInput: $('person-name'), errPerson: $('err-person'),
    peopleTitle: $('people-title'), peopleList: $('people-list'), peopleEmpty: $('people-empty'),
    peopleNote: $('people-note'), sampleBtn: $('sample-trip'),
    expenseForm: $('expense-form'), descInput: $('expense-desc'), amountInput: $('expense-amount'),
    payerSel: $('expense-payer'), splitBox: $('expense-split'), splitTools: $('split-tools'),
    splitAll: $('split-all'), splitNone: $('split-none'), preview: $('split-preview'),
    errDesc: $('err-desc'), errAmount: $('err-amount'), errPayer: $('err-payer'),
    errSplit: $('err-split'), errExpense: $('err-expense'), success: $('expense-success'),
    balAxis: $('balance-axis'), balList: $('balance-list'), balEmpty: $('balance-empty'), balCheck: $('balance-check'),
    settleSummary: $('settle-summary'), transferList: $('transfer-list'), settleEmpty: $('settle-empty'),
    settleFoot: $('settle-foot'), settleActions: $('settle-actions'), copyBtn: $('copy-settle'), copyStatus: $('copy-status'),
    expTitle: $('expenses-title'), expCount: $('expense-count'), expSummary: $('expenses-summary'),
    expList: $('expense-list'), expEmpty: $('expense-empty'),
    undoBar: $('undo-bar'), undoText: $('undo-text'), undoBtn: $('undo-btn'), undoDismiss: $('undo-dismiss'),
    reset: $('reset'), resetStart: $('reset-start'), resetConfirm: $('reset-confirm'),
    resetKeep: $('reset-keep'), resetGo: $('reset-go'),
    storageNote: $('storage-note'), announcer: $('announcer')
  };

  /* ---------- State & storage ---------- */
  let state = { people: [], expenses: [] };
  let undoState = null;
  let storageOk = true;
  let justAddedId = null;
  let controlsSig = null;
  let currentError = null;

  function uid() {
    try {
      if (window.crypto && typeof window.crypto.randomUUID === 'function') return window.crypto.randomUUID();
    } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
    return 'id-' + Date.now().toString(36) + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);
  }

  function load() {
    let raw = null;
    try { raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY); }
    catch (e) { storageOk = false; }
    const fresh = { people: [], expenses: [] };
    if (!raw) { state = fresh; return; }
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(raw);
      const ids = new Set();
      const names = new Set();
      if (data && Array.isArray(data.people)) {
        for (const p of data.people) {
          if (!p || typeof p.id !== 'string' || typeof p.name !== 'string') continue;
          const name = p.name.trim();
          if (!name || ids.has(p.id) || names.has(keyOf(name))) continue;
          ids.add(p.id); names.add(keyOf(name));
          fresh.people.push({ id: p.id, name });
        }
      }
      if (data && Array.isArray(data.expenses)) {
        for (const e of data.expenses) {
          if (!e || typeof e.id !== 'string' || typeof e.desc !== 'string') continue;
          if (!Number.isSafeInteger(e.cents) || e.cents <= 0 || e.cents > MAX_CENTS) continue;
          if (!ids.has(e.payerId) || !Array.isArray(e.splitIds)) continue;
          const wanted = new Set(e.splitIds);
          const split = fresh.people.filter((p) => wanted.has(p.id)).map((p) => p.id);
          if (!split.length) continue;
          fresh.expenses.push({
            id: e.id, desc: e.desc.trim() || 'Expense', cents: e.cents,
            payerId: e.payerId, splitIds: split, at: typeof e.at === 'number' ? e.at : 0
          });
        }
      }
      state = fresh;
    } catch (e) {
      state = { people: [], expenses: [] };
    }
  }

  function save() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ version: 1, people: state.people, expenses: state.expenses }));
      storageOk = true;
    } catch (e) {
      storageOk = false;
    }
    ui.storageNote.hidden = storageOk;
  }

  /* ---------- Money logic ---------- */
  function parseAmount(raw) {
    let s = String(raw == null ? '' : raw).trim();
    if (!s) return { error: 'empty' };
    s = s.replace(/^(?:CA)?\$\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*CAD$/i, '').trim();
    let negative = false;
    if (/^[-\u2212]/.test(s)) {
      negative = true;
      s = s.replace(/^[-\u2212]\s*/, '').replace(/^(?:CA)?\$\s*/i, '');
    }
    if (/^\d{1,3}(,\d{3})+(\.\d*)?$/.test(s)) s = s.replace(/,/g, '');
    const m = /^(\d*)(?:\.(\d*))?$/.exec(s);
    if (!m || (!m[1] && !m[2])) return { error: 'format' };
    const whole = m[1].replace(/^0+(?=\d)/, '');
    const frac = m[2] || '';
    if (frac.length > 2) return { error: 'decimals' };
    if (negative) return { error: 'notPositive' };
    if (whole.length > 8) return { error: 'tooBig' };
    const cents = Number(whole || '0') * 100 + Number((frac + '00').slice(0, 2));
    if (cents <= 0) return { error: 'notPositive' };
    if (cents > MAX_CENTS) return { error: 'tooBig' };
    return { cents };
  }

  // Equal split in integer cents; leftover cents go one each, in trip order.
  function shares(cents, count) {
    const base = Math.floor(cents / count);
    const extra = cents - base * count;
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) out.push(base + (i < extra ? 1 : 0));
    return out;
  }

  function splitPeople(e) {
    const ids = new Set(e.splitIds);
    return state.people.filter((p) => ids.has(p.id));
  }

  function involvedIds() {
    const s = new Set();
    for (const e of state.expenses) {
      s.add(e.payerId);
      for (const id of e.splitIds) s.add(id);
    }
    return s;
  }

  function computeBalances() {
    const rows = state.people.map((p, index) => ({ person: p, index, paid: 0, share: 0, net: 0 }));
    const byId = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.person.id, r]));
    for (const e of state.expenses) {
      const payer = byId.get(e.payerId);
      if (payer) payer.paid += e.cents;
      const split = splitPeople(e);
      if (!split.length) continue;
      const s = shares(e.cents, split.length);
      split.forEach((p, i) => { byId.get(p.id).share += s[i]; });
    }
    for (const r of rows) r.net = r.paid - r.share;
    return rows;
  }

  // Greedy: largest debtor pays largest creditor. Every step clears at least one
  // balance and the last clears two, so transfers <= (non-zero balances - 1).
  function computeTransfers(rows) {
    const cred = rows.filter((r) => r.net > 0).map((r) => ({ r, left: r.net }));
    const debt = rows.filter((r) => r.net < 0).map((r) => ({ r, left: -r.net }));
    const order = (a, b) => (b.left - a.left) || (a.r.index - b.r.index);
    const out = [];
    let guard = 0;
    while (cred.length && debt.length && guard++ < 100000) {
      cred.sort(order); debt.sort(order);
      const c = cred[0], d = debt[0];
      const amt = Math.min(c.left, d.left);
      if (amt <= 0) break;
      out.push({ from: d.r.person, to: c.r.person, cents: amt });
      c.left -= amt; d.left -= amt;
      if (c.left === 0) cred.shift();
      if (d.left === 0) debt.shift();
    }
    return out;
  }

  function shareSentence(cents, names) {
    const n = names.length;
    const base = Math.floor(cents / n);
    const extra = cents - base * n;
    if (!extra) return fmt(base) + ' each';
    const more = names.slice(0, extra);
    const rest = names.slice(extra);
    const restLabel = rest.length > 2 ? 'everyone else' : joinNames(rest);
    return fmt(base + 1) + ' for ' + joinNames(more) + ', ' + fmt(base) + ' for ' + restLabel;
  }

  /* ---------- Messages ---------- */
  let announceTimer;
  function announce(msg) {
    clearTimeout(announceTimer);
    ui.announcer.textContent = '';
    announceTimer = setTimeout(() => { ui.announcer.textContent = msg; }, 60);
  }

  function clearErrors() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="form-error"]').forEach((n) => n.remove());
    document.querySelectorAll('[aria-invalid="true"]').forEach((n) => n.removeAttribute('aria-invalid'));
    currentError = null;
  }

  function showError(slot, control, msg) {
    clearErrors();
    ui.success.hidden = true;
    slot.append(h('p', { class: 'form-error', 'data-testid': 'form-error' }, icon('alert'), h('span', null, msg)));
    if (control) {
      control.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
      control.focus();
    }
    currentError = { slot, control };
  }

  let successTimer;
  function flashSuccess(text) {
    ui.success.replaceChildren(icon('check'), h('span', null, text));
    ui.success.hidden = false;
    clearTimeout(successTimer);
    successTimer = setTimeout(() => { ui.success.hidden = true; }, 6000);
  }

  /* ---------- Rendering ---------- */
  function renderControls() {
    const sig = state.people.map((p) => p.id + ':' + p.name).join('|');
    if (sig === controlsSig) return;
    controlsSig = sig;

    const prevChecked = new Map();
    ui.splitBox.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]').forEach((cb) => prevChecked.set(cb.dataset.id, cb.checked));
    const prevOpt = ui.payerSel.selectedOptions && ui.payerSel.selectedOptions[0];
    const prevPayerId = prevOpt ? prevOpt.dataset.id : undefined;

    ui.payerSel.replaceChildren();
    if (!state.people.length) {
      ui.payerSel.append(h('option', { value: '' }, 'Add people first'));
      ui.payerSel.disabled = true;
    } else {
      ui.payerSel.disabled = false;
      for (const p of state.people) ui.payerSel.append(h('option', { value: p.name, 'data-id': p.id }, p.name));
      const keep = state.people.find((p) => p.id === prevPayerId);
      ui.payerSel.value = keep ? keep.name : state.people[0].name;
    }

    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    if (!state.people.length) {
      frag.append(h('p', { class: 'split-empty' }, 'Everyone you add to the trip shows up here, ready to share costs.'));
    }
    for (const p of state.people) {
      const cb = h('input', { type: 'checkbox', value: p.name, 'data-id': p.id, 'aria-describedby': 'err-split' });
      cb.checked = prevChecked.has(p.id) ? prevChecked.get(p.id) : true;
      frag.append(h('label', { class: 'check-chip' }, cb, h('span', { class: 'check-name' }, p.name)));
    }
    ui.splitBox.replaceChildren(frag);
    ui.splitTools.hidden = state.people.length < 2;
  }

  function checkedPeople() {
    const names = new Set(Array.from(ui.splitBox.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]:checked'), (cb) => cb.value));
    return state.people.filter((p) => names.has(p.name));
  }

  function updatePreview() {
    if (!state.people.length) { ui.preview.hidden = true; return; }
    ui.preview.hidden = false;
    const chosen = checkedPeople();
    const parsed = parseAmount(ui.amountInput.value);
    const kids = [];
    if (!chosen.length) {
      kids.push(h('span', { class: 'pv-main' }, 'No one is selected yet. Choose who shares this cost.'));
    } else if (parsed.error) {
      kids.push(h('span', { class: 'pv-main' }, chosen.length === 1
        ? 'All of it counts toward ' + chosen[0].name + '’s share.'
        : 'Shared ' + chosen.length + ' ways. Enter an amount to see each share.'));
    } else if (chosen.length === 1) {
      kids.push(h('span', { class: 'pv-main' }, h('strong', null, chosen[0].name + '’s share'), ' ' + fmt(parsed.cents)));
    } else {
      const n = chosen.length;
      const extra = parsed.cents % n;
      kids.push(h('span', { class: 'pv-main' },
        h('strong', null, extra ? 'Shares' : 'Each share'), ' ',
        extra ? shareSentence(parsed.cents, chosen.map((p) => p.name)) : fmt(parsed.cents / n)));
      if (extra) {
        kids.push(h('span', { class: 'pv-note' }, extra === 1
          ? 'The leftover cent goes to whoever joined the trip first.'
          : 'Leftover cents go one each to people in the order they joined the trip.'));
      }
    }
    ui.preview.replaceChildren(...kids);
  }

  function renderStats() {
    const total = state.expenses.reduce((s, e) => s + e.cents, 0);
    ui.statTotal.textContent = fmt(total);
    ui.statPeople.textContent = String(state.people.length);
    ui.statExpenses.textContent = String(state.expenses.length);
    return total;
  }

  function renderPeople() {
    const involved = involvedIds();
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    for (const p of state.people) {
      const locked = involved.has(p.id);
      const li = h('li', { class: 'person-chip' + (locked ? ' is-locked' : '') },
        mono(p.name),
        h('span', { class: 'person-name', 'data-testid': 'person' }, p.name));
      if (!locked) {
        li.append(h('button', {
          type: 'button', class: 'chip-remove', 'data-remove-person': p.id,
          'aria-label': 'Remove ' + p.name + ' from the trip', title: 'Remove ' + p.name
        }, icon('x')));
      }
      frag.append(li);
    }
    ui.peopleList.replaceChildren(frag);
    const n = state.people.length;
    ui.peopleList.hidden = n === 0;
    ui.peopleEmpty.hidden = n > 0;
    ui.sampleBtn.hidden = n > 0 || state.expenses.length > 0;
    if (!n) { ui.peopleNote.hidden = true; return; }
    const bits = [n + ' ' + plural(n, 'person', 'people') + ' on this trip.'];
    if (n === 1) bits.push('Add at least one more to start splitting.');
    else if (involved.size) bits.push('You can remove someone until they’re part of an expense.');
    ui.peopleNote.textContent = bits.join(' ');
    ui.peopleNote.hidden = false;
  }

  function renderBalances(rows) {
    const has = rows.length > 0;
    ui.balAxis.hidden = !has;
    ui.balList.hidden = !has;
    ui.balEmpty.hidden = has;
    if (!has) { ui.balList.replaceChildren(); ui.balCheck.hidden = true; return; }

    const max = rows.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, Math.abs(r.net)), 0);
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    for (const r of rows) {
      const kind = r.net > 0 ? 'pos' : (r.net < 0 ? 'neg' : 'zero');
      const label = kind === 'pos' ? 'Gets back' : (kind === 'neg' ? 'Owes' : 'All square');
      const pct = max ? Math.max((Math.abs(r.net) / max) * 50, 1.5) : 0;
      frag.append(h('li', {
        class: 'bal is-' + kind, 'data-testid': 'balance',
        'data-person': r.person.name, 'data-cents': String(r.net)
      },
        mono(r.person.name),
        h('div', { class: 'bal-who' },
          h('p', { class: 'bal-name' }, r.person.name),
          h('p', { class: 'bal-meta' },
            h('span', null, 'Paid ' + fmt(r.paid)),
            h('span', { class: 'sep', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, '·'),
            ' ',
            h('span', null, 'Share ' + fmt(r.share)))),
        h('p', { class: 'bal-fig' },
          h('span', { class: 'bal-label' }, label),
          ' ',
          h('span', { class: 'bal-amt' }, fmt(Math.abs(r.net)))),
        h('div', { class: 'bal-bar', 'aria-hidden': 'true' },
          kind === 'zero' ? null : h('span', { class: 'bal-fill ' + kind, style: '--w:' + pct.toFixed(2) + '%' }))
      ));
    }
    ui.balList.replaceChildren(frag);

    const sum = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.net, 0);
    if (state.expenses.length) {
      ui.balCheck.replaceChildren(icon('check'), h('span', null,
        'Every cent is accounted for. Balances add up to ' + fmt(sum) + '.'));
    } else {
      ui.balCheck.replaceChildren(h('span', null, 'Everyone starts at $0.00. Log an expense to see balances move.'));
    }
    ui.balCheck.hidden = false;
  }

  function renderSettle(rows) {
    const transfers = computeTransfers(rows);
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    for (const t of transfers) {
      frag.append(h('li', {
        class: 'transfer', 'data-testid': 'transfer',
        'data-from': t.from.name, 'data-to': t.to.name, 'data-cents': String(t.cents)
      },
        h('p', { class: 't-who' },
          h('span', { class: 't-name' }, t.from.name),
          ' ',
          h('span', { class: 't-verb' }, 'pays', icon('arrow')),
          ' ',
          h('span', { class: 't-name' }, t.to.name)),
        ' ',
        h('p', { class: 't-amt' }, fmt(t.cents))
      ));
    }
    ui.transferList.replaceChildren(frag);
    ui.copyStatus.textContent = '';

    const n = transfers.length;
    ui.transferList.hidden = n === 0;
    ui.settleSummary.hidden = n === 0;
    ui.settleFoot.hidden = n === 0;
    ui.settleActions.hidden = n === 0;
    ui.settleEmpty.hidden = n > 0;

    if (n) {
      ui.settleSummary.textContent = n + ' ' + plural(n, 'payment settles', 'payments settle') + ' the whole trip.';
      return;
    }
    if (!state.people.length) {
      ui.settleEmpty.replaceChildren(h('p', null, 'Add people and log what they paid. The payments that even everyone out will show up here.'));
    } else if (!state.expenses.length) {
      ui.settleEmpty.replaceChildren(h('p', null, h('strong', null, 'Nothing to settle yet.'), ' Once you log an expense, you’ll see exactly who pays whom.'));
    } else {
      ui.settleEmpty.replaceChildren(h('div', { class: 'settle-even' }, icon('check'),
        h('p', null, h('span', { class: 'even-title' }, 'Everyone’s even.'), 'No one needs to pay anyone.')));
    }
  }

  function renderExpenses(total) {
    const byId = new Map(state.people.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    const list = state.expenses.slice().reverse();
    for (const e of list) {
      const payer = byId.get(e.payerId) || { name: 'Someone' };
      const names = splitPeople(e).map((p) => p.name);
      const splitText = names.length === 1 ? 'For ' + names[0] + ' only' : 'Split between ' + joinNames(names);
      const shareText = names.length > 1 ? shareSentence(e.cents, names) : '';
      frag.append(h('li', { class: 'exp' + (e.id === justAddedId ? ' is-new' : ''), 'data-testid': 'expense', 'data-id': e.id },
        h('h3', { class: 'exp-desc' }, e.desc),
        h('p', { class: 'exp-amt' }, fmt(e.cents)),
        h('p', { class: 'exp-payer' }, mono(payer.name, 'sm'), h('span', null, 'Paid by ', h('strong', null, payer.name))),
        h('p', { class: 'exp-split' }, splitText),
        h('p', { class: 'exp-share' }, shareText),
        h('div', { class: 'exp-act' },
          h('button', { type: 'button', class: 'btn btn-quiet btn-small', 'data-testid': 'delete-expense', 'data-id': e.id },
            'Remove', h('span', { class: 'sr-only' }, ' ' + e.desc)))
      ));
    }
    ui.expList.replaceChildren(frag);
    const n = state.expenses.length;
    ui.expList.hidden = n === 0;
    ui.expEmpty.hidden = n > 0;
    ui.expCount.hidden = n === 0;
    ui.expCount.textContent = String(n);
    ui.expSummary.textContent = n
      ? fmt(total) + ' across ' + n + ' ' + plural(n, 'expense', 'expenses') + '. Newest first.'
      : 'Everything anyone paid for, newest first.';
  }

  function renderUndo() {
    if (undoState) {
      ui.undoText.textContent = 'Removed “' + undoState.expense.desc + '” (' + fmt(undoState.expense.cents) + ').';
      ui.undoBar.hidden = false;
    } else {
      ui.undoBar.hidden = true;
    }
  }

  function renderReset() {
    const empty = !state.people.length && !state.expenses.length;
    ui.reset.hidden = empty;
    if (empty) { ui.resetConfirm.hidden = true; ui.resetStart.hidden = false; }
  }

  function render() {
    renderControls();
    const rows = computeBalances();
    const total = renderStats();
    renderPeople();
    renderBalances(rows);
    renderSettle(rows);
    renderExpenses(total);
    renderUndo();
    renderReset();
    updatePreview();
    ui.storageNote.hidden = storageOk;
  }

  /* ---------- People ---------- */
  ui.personForm.addEventListener('submit', (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    clearErrors();
    const name = ui.personInput.value.trim();
    if (!name) {
      showError(ui.errPerson, ui.personInput, 'Type a name first, then add them to the trip.');
      return;
    }
    if (name.length > MAX_NAME) {
      showError(ui.errPerson, ui.personInput, 'Keep names to ' + MAX_NAME + ' characters or fewer so they fit everywhere.');
      return;
    }
    const dup = state.people.find((p) => keyOf(p.name) === keyOf(name));
    if (dup) {
      showError(ui.errPerson, ui.personInput,
        dup.name + ' is already on the trip. If this is someone else, add a last initial, like “' + dup.name + ' B.”');
      return;
    }
    state.people.push({ id: uid(), name });
    undoState = null;
    save();
    render();
    ui.personInput.value = '';
    ui.personInput.focus();
    const n = state.people.length;
    announce('Added ' + name + ' to the trip. ' + n + ' ' + plural(n, 'person', 'people') + ' so far.');
  });

  ui.peopleList.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
    const btn = ev.target.closest('[data-remove-person]');
    if (!btn) return;
    const id = btn.getAttribute('data-remove-person');
    const idx = state.people.findIndex((p) => p.id === id);
    if (idx < 0 || involvedIds().has(id)) return;
    const removed = state.people.splice(idx, 1)[0];
    undoState = null;
    clearErrors();
    save();
    render();
    const candidates = [state.people[idx], state.people[idx - 1]].filter(Boolean);
    let target = null;
    for (const p of candidates) {
      const b = Array.from(ui.peopleList.querySelectorAll('[data-remove-person]'))
        .find((x) => x.getAttribute('data-remove-person') === p.id);
      if (b) { target = b; break; }
    }
    (target || ui.personInput).focus();
    announce('Removed ' + removed.name + ' from the trip.');
  });

  ui.sampleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (state.people.length || state.expenses.length) return;
    const people = ['Ana', 'Ben', 'Chloé', 'Dev'].map((name) => ({ id: uid(), name }));
    const [a, b, c, d] = people.map((p) => p.id);
    const all = people.map((p) => p.id);
    const now = Date.now();
    state = {
      people,
      expenses: [
        { id: uid(), desc: 'Cabin, two nights', cents: 48000, payerId: a, splitIds: all, at: now - 4000 },
        { id: uid(), desc: 'Groceries for the weekend', cents: 13657, payerId: b, splitIds: all, at: now - 3000 },
        { id: uid(), desc: 'Ferry tickets', cents: 9240, payerId: c, splitIds: [a, c, d], at: now - 2000 },
        { id: uid(), desc: 'Canoe rental', cents: 7500, payerId: d, splitIds: [b, d], at: now - 1000 }
      ]
    };
    undoState = null;
    clearErrors();
    save();
    render();
    ui.peopleTitle.focus();
    announce('Loaded a sample trip with 4 people and 4 expenses. You can start a new trip at the bottom of the page.');
  });

  /* ---------- Expenses ---------- */
  ui.expenseForm.addEventListener('submit', (ev) => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    clearErrors();
    if (!state.people.length) {
      showError(ui.errExpense, null, 'Add the people on the trip first. Then you can log what they paid for.');
      return;
    }
    const desc = ui.descInput.value.trim();
    if (!desc) {
      showError(ui.errDesc, ui.descInput, 'Add a short description, like “Groceries” or “Ferry tickets”.');
      return;
    }
    if (desc.length > MAX_DESC) {
      showError(ui.errDesc, ui.descInput, 'Keep the description to ' + MAX_DESC + ' characters or fewer.');
      return;
    }
    const parsed = parseAmount(ui.amountInput.value);
    if (parsed.error) {
      showError(ui.errAmount, ui.amountInput, AMOUNT_ERRORS[parsed.error]);
      return;
    }
    const payer = state.people.find((p) => p.name === ui.payerSel.value);
    if (!payer) {
      showError(ui.errPayer, ui.payerSel, 'Choose who paid for this.');
      return;
    }
    const split = checkedPeople();
    if (!split.length) {
      const first = ui.splitBox.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
      showError(ui.errSplit, first, 'Choose at least one person to share this cost.');
      return;
    }
    const exp = {
      id: uid(), desc, cents: parsed.cents, payerId: payer.id,
      splitIds: split.map((p) => p.id), at: Date.now()
    };
    state.expenses.push(exp);
    undoState = null;
    save();
    justAddedId = exp.id;
    render();
    justAddedId = null;

    ui.descInput.value = '';
    ui.amountInput.value = '';
    ui.splitBox.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]').forEach((cb) => { cb.checked = true; });
    updatePreview();
    ui.descInput.focus();
    flashSuccess('Added “' + desc + '”, ' + fmt(exp.cents));
    announce('Added ' + desc + ', ' + fmt(exp.cents) + ', paid by ' + payer.name + '. ' +
      (split.length === 1 ? 'For ' + split[0].name + ' only.' : 'Split between ' + split.length + ' people.'));
  });

  ui.amountInput.addEventListener('input', updatePreview);
  ui.splitBox.addEventListener('change', () => {
    if (currentError && currentError.slot === ui.errSplit) clearErrors();
    updatePreview();
  });
  ui.splitAll.addEventListener('click', () => {
    ui.splitBox.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]').forEach((cb) => { cb.checked = true; });
    if (currentError && currentError.slot === ui.errSplit) clearErrors();
    updatePreview();
    announce('Everyone is selected.');
  });
  ui.splitNone.addEventListener('click', () => {
    ui.splitBox.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]').forEach((cb) => { cb.checked = false; });
    updatePreview();
    announce('No one is selected.');
  });

  document.addEventListener('input', (ev) => {
    if (currentError && currentError.control && currentError.control === ev.target) clearErrors();
  });

  ui.expList.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
    const btn = ev.target.closest('[data-testid="delete-expense"]');
    if (!btn) return;
    const id = btn.getAttribute('data-id');
    const idx = state.expenses.findIndex((x) => x.id === id);
    if (idx < 0) return;
    const shownIdx = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(ui.expList.children, btn.closest('li'));
    const removed = state.expenses.splice(idx, 1)[0];
    undoState = { expense: removed, index: idx };
    clearErrors();
    save();
    render();
    const btns = ui.expList.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="delete-expense"]');
    const next = btns[shownIdx] || btns[shownIdx - 1];
    (next || ui.undoBtn).focus();
    announce('Removed ' + removed.desc + '. You can undo this from the top of the expense list.');
  });

  ui.undoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!undoState) return;
    const { expense, index } = undoState;
    const ids = new Set(state.people.map((p) => p.id));
    undoState = null;
    if (!ids.has(expense.payerId) || !expense.splitIds.some((x) => ids.has(x))) {
      render();
      ui.expTitle.focus();
      announce('That expense can’t be brought back because someone in it has left the trip.');
      return;
    }
    expense.splitIds = expense.splitIds.filter((x) => ids.has(x));
    state.expenses.splice(Math.min(index, state.expenses.length), 0, expense);
    save();
    justAddedId = expense.id;
    render();
    justAddedId = null;
    const restored = Array.from(ui.expList.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="delete-expense"]'))
      .find((b) => b.getAttribute('data-id') === expense.id);
    (restored || ui.expTitle).focus();
    announce('Brought back ' + expense.desc + '.');
  });

  ui.undoDismiss.addEventListener('click', () => {
    undoState = null;
    renderUndo();
    ui.expTitle.focus();
  });

  /* ---------- Settle up: copy ---------- */
  function fallbackCopy(text) {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.top = '-1000px';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.append(ta);
    ta.select();
    let ok = false;
    try { ok = document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) { ok = false; }
    ta.remove();
    ui.copyBtn.focus();
    return ok;
  }

  ui.copyBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const transfers = computeTransfers(computeBalances());
    if (!transfers.length) return;
    const text = ['Settle up (from Even Keel)']
      .concat(transfers.map((t) => t.from.name + ' pays ' + t.to.name + ' ' + fmt(t.cents)))
      .join('\n');
    let ok = false;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      ok = true;
    } catch (e) {
      ok = fallbackCopy(text);
    }
    ui.copyStatus.textContent = ok
      ? 'Copied. Paste it wherever your group chats.'
      : 'Couldn’t copy here. You can select the list and copy it instead.';
  });

  /* ---------- Reset ---------- */
  ui.resetStart.addEventListener('click', () => {
    ui.resetConfirm.hidden = false;
    ui.resetStart.hidden = true;
    ui.resetKeep.focus();
  });
  ui.resetKeep.addEventListener('click', () => {
    ui.resetConfirm.hidden = true;
    ui.resetStart.hidden = false;
    ui.resetStart.focus();
  });
  ui.resetGo.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state = { people: [], expenses: [] };
    undoState = null;
    clearErrors();
    ui.descInput.value = '';
    ui.amountInput.value = '';
    ui.personInput.value = '';
    ui.success.hidden = true;
    save();
    render();
    ui.personInput.focus();
    announce('Started a new trip. Everyone and every expense has been cleared.');
  });

  /* ---------- Sync across tabs ---------- */
  window.addEventListener('storage', (ev) => {
    if (ev.key !== STORAGE_KEY && ev.key !== null) return;
    load();
    undoState = null;
    clearErrors();
    render();
  });

  load();
  render();
})();
</script>
